1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Wizards led 32–31 after one quarter. At the half, the Pistons led 68–58.

Scroll to keep going
2 of 5 · The difference

Collins: 24 points, a season high

9 of 13 from the floor, 10 rebounds, 15 by halftime.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the second quarter 37–26

Down 1 after one quarter, the Pistons won the second quarter 37–26 to lead 68–58. Collins, Robinson and Jenkins combined for 68 of 122.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it running and at the line

Fast-break points 19–4; assists 31–16. Washington turned it over 18 times to Detroit’s 10.

5 of 5 · Final

Pistons 122, Wizards 111.

From the Wizards’ side: Lost the second quarter 26–37, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Pistons 8–3, 3rd in the East, 97% top-6 odds. Wizards 4–9, 12th in the East, 4%.
